name: My Pet Knight
source:
8th episode in My pet Ragnarok series.
Nina hates the dark merchant. But she gets caught in his trap and is trained with spores, candles, ropes, whips, tentacles... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《我的宠物仙境传说》系列的第八集。
尼娜讨厌黑暗商人。但她却落入了他的陷阱，并接受了孢子、蜡烛、绳索、鞭子、触手的训练…… 

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
